checked.how: Row has overflow-x:auto, scroll-snap-type:x mandatory, scrollbar-width:none. Cards have min-width calc(s7*2)=96px, flex 0 1 144px, scroll-snap-align:start. Stage track-select.stage.ts builds 4 real + 4 fixture cards, so 8 radios. The 844x390 screenshot shows 4 whole cards and QUARRY RUN peeking at the row edge.

checked.target: AC2 RACE fixed, last card reachable, no document h-scroll
checked.how: RACE is a sibling of the row in .ui-start__select (start-screen.ts:95), not inside the scroller, so scrolling the row can't move it. The row's -12px margin plus 12px padding keeps its content box the same as before. Screenshot shows RACE in the same place as in start--menu.

click on a locked card calls shakeLocked: cancels the previous Animation, then element.animate with keyframes translateX 0,4,-4,4,0 (tokens.space.s1), duration motion.durationMs.wipe, easing snap, no fill. onPick isn't called, so aria-checked can't change. Cancel-then-animate means at most one animation runs.

keydown fires only when locked and the key is Enter or ' ', with no modifier. It calls preventDefault (no page scroll) and shakes; it never focuses or picks. The group's arrow handler ignores these keys, and arrows return early in the card handler. Focus doesn't move.

shakeLocked checks reducedMotion() (now exported from screen-change.ts, same matchMedia query) at the moment of activation and sets shake = null without animating. The locked hover/active/focus-visible CSS rule plus the reduced-motion block keep transform none.

The .ui-track-card[aria-disabled='true']:hover/:active rule (0,3,0) comes after the @media(hover) lift rule (0,3,0), so it wins: transform none, shadow-button. Release fires click, which shakes. Unlocked cards keep the lift (--ui-card-lift negative).
